item.title: Hackers target over 30 Minnesota water utilities in coordinated OT attack
item.dc:creator: Ionut Ilascu
item.description: The Minnesota IT Services (MNIT) agency activated its cybersecurity incident response capabilities across the entire state after hackers targeted more than 30 community water systems in "a coordinated cyberattack." [...]

item.title: Your AI Agents Are Guessing at Scale: Permissions Decide the Damage
item.dc:creator: Sponsored by Token Security
item.description: AI agents are designed to improvise as they complete tasks, making broad permissions a growing security risk. Token Security explains why identity, intent-based access controls, and least privilege are becoming the foundation for securing agentic AI. [...]

item.title: Windows 11 KB5101684 update released with 42 changes and fixes
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Abrams
item.description: ​​Microsoft has released the KB5101684 preview cumulative update for Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2, which 42 bug fixes and additional feature improvements for the operating system. [...]

item.title: OpenAI models used Artifactory zero-days to escape to the internet
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Abrams
item.description: JFrog has confirmed that OpenAI models exploited zero-day vulnerabilities in self-hosted Artifactory servers to help escape an isolated testing environment and gain access to the internet before attacking Hugging Face. [...]

item.title: CISA shares advice on isolating vital systems during cyberattacks
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Abrams
item.description: The U.S. and Australian governments have released new guidance urging critical infrastructure organizations to prepare to isolate vital operational technology systems in the event of a cyberattack or other major disruptions. [...]

item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: More than 24,000 internet-exposed servers are leaking authentication password hashes due to a 20-year-old vulnerability in their Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) interface. [...]
